steps.text: *rustle*, *rustle*—
A sudden noise interrupts Chilchuck from his dream.
Ever since he arrived here, even the slightest noise would stir him awake.
He fails to make sense of his dream and stands up, looking towards Laios, who is keeping watch.
Fortunately, the tallman who's usually blunt and awkward is very reliable when it counts.
He has already awakened Senshi and Marcille, and has his weapon ready.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Chilchuck, we'll draw their attention while you scout them out.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Got it.
Chilchuck discovers the sound came from a pack of monsters they've seen before, and they had yet to notice them.
He breathes a sigh of relief and returns to his companions with the news.
Since arriving in this world called Terra, the adventure party has seen too many strange sights.
They exchange glances, and make sure everyone is ready for combat.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Alright, let's go!

As he charges, Laios can't help but think of all the dangers they'll need to avoid in this unknown world. Whether with the help of that Rhodes Island or relying on themselves, they'll have to return home.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Phew... it's finally over.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I was having such a wonderful dream too. What a waste.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Considering how carelessly you spread out when you sleep, you must have wonderful dreams every day.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I don't... Wait, I don't do that, do I?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: No, I was just making an educated guess.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You know, we've been walking through this forest for a few days now.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Are there really Sami tribes living here?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: The Sami locals like to live in odd locations, and most aren't exactly welcoming of outsiders.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: So it won't be easy to find them.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: True... *sigh* I didn't think they'd live in such a remote place.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Weren't you the one who wanted to look for a snowpriest, Marcille? Are you giving up already?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Well, I didn't know this place would be so scary!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: When we had just arrived in Sami, it looked so pleasant...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I heard all kinds of interesting stories, too. There was a small 'Basque Astrology' tent where they were telling fortunes.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I mean, I did later find out she was a fraud controlling the crystal ball directly, but her story about the 'thousand-headed monster of Minoan myth' was still fascinating.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I wonder if we could actually find it in Minos.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I've also heard tales of a powerful monster that gains the abilities of whatever it eats.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I wish I had that ability...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Of course that's the part that gets your blood racing.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Let's see if we can find a snowpriest before my legs completely give up on me...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The strong adapt to their circumstances, Marcille.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Well, don't worry about me adapting to this environment, because I'm never coming back here. Ever.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Thinking like that will only hinder your growth.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'd much rather trek through a place like this than stroll down a paved street.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Look, I'm not saying we should give up on the snowpriest.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But the fortune teller said we'd find them in the Myrkwood, and what have we found? Nothing!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's dark, damp, there are just as many monsters as there are trees, and our supplies are nearly gone. And THAT means we're going to be eating monsters, again.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What do you think, Laios?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm... the ones we've run into so far don't seem all that different from the ones we've seen before. I thought we'd get to see some rarer monsters in here.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Forests don't give up their secrets that easily. We just haven't discovered them yet.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Speaking of eating monsters, looks like the two of them are already carving one up. Isn't it great, Marcille? You're in for another treat.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: NO WAY ABSOLUTELY NOT NO NO NO!!!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Another one?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wha?
Looks like I got here too late.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios, could you maybe not greet someone while wiping your face with the hand holding your bloody sword and holding monster meat with the other?
Oh, it's fine.
I've seen much worse. Trust me.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: You can call me Oakcup. I'm an apprentice shaman.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: A flock of fowlbeasts told me your location, so I hurried over.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Though, I'm sure you could have handled yourselves fine even without me.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Oh, please don't worry. I come with no ill intent. Seeing how well you're doing, I won't bother you any longer—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, did you just call yourself an apprentice shaman?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We entered this forest hoping to find a Sami snowpriest to divine a way home for us. Or at least... to help us find Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: A way home?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yeah. For whatever reason, we don't even know how to do that.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: As for Rhodes Island, a while back someone told us to look for them for help, but we haven't been able to find them.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: There are many in the south who are eager to 'guide' others.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oh, we've been to one of those. 'Basque Astrology.'

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Thanks to them, outsiders often come to the same misconception you have.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: We rarely predict the futures or wishes of others. We look into the future to ensure our own survival.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: We only request Samivilinn's guidance when absolutely necessary.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: We pray for Sami to warn us of any dangers ahead so we can prepare for them, but beyond that we live by the laws of nature.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Laws of nature?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: No different from how you've been living.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Hunt or be hunted; Live and eat, or die and be eaten.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, I knew I liked this place.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...I have a question.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Does your Sami show up in dreams?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Hmm... I haven't encountered it myself, but it's not entirely impossible to receive a revelation that way.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: After all, who can say if our dreams are true or false?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Did you have a dream about the future?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Nope.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Alright, Mister Mysterious.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So you won't be taking us to a snowpriest?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Hm... It's not that I'm unwilling to, but I'd find it quite troublesome.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Though, if you really do approach another tribe's shaman, they might just chase you off.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: What would take the least time and effort...?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh? Did the tree beside us just... drop two pieces of bark?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: There are strange runes on them, too... Which I can't read, of course.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Oh? Can I take a look?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Sure enough, Sami has sent you a guide.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Thank you, Sami. You sure have saved me a lot of trouble.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What are these pieces of bark...?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Those are Foldartals. They represent Sami's will itself.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Shamans have many ways of glimpsing into the future, but sometimes, Sami will also proactively cast us a glance, just like this.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sounds a bit too convenient to me.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: I think so too, sometimes.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: But on the other hand, wouldn't you have been even more frustrated if you couldn't find anyone to read these Fordartals for you?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Why are you so casual about all this? Aren't you an apprentice shaman? Do you people not take your work seriously?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: I asked my teacher that once, and he answered by drinking wine out of my horns for the next two days. Never dared to ask again.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So can you tell us what's on them?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: The first one... 'North'?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You mean we should head north?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: You're already northward bound, but Sami still says 'north.'

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Perhaps It wants you to go even further north.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Even further? What's up there, Chilchuck?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: The map says that once you leave the Myrkwood, you'll be in the center of Sami's forest. Further north of that are the huge snow-covered mountains and the endless icefields.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Don't tell me Sami wants us to go to the icefields?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Samivilinn often only casts a vague image.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: But if you were to ask me, I'd say so, yes.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: The endless icefields? I asked around about them, and that's not the kinda place you return from.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: But you just said earlier that you don't know how to get home.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: An undiscovered path hidden in a place from which none have returned. Perfect, no?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: As for the other piece... 'Hermit.' Haha. Interesting.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: And what does that mean?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: It can mean many things... but if you're talking about a 'hermit' in the 'north,' then there's really only one thing it could be referring to.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: The Cyclopes.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: THE WHAT?!

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: You know of the Cyclopes?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I... heard about them when I was gathering information.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Is that a kind of monster?

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Um... no, they're a special kind of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: They use a completely different way to tell the future than we Sami do.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: And they just happen to live in seclusion, deep within the mountains to the north.

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Put the two Foldartals together, and I think this is what Sami is trying to tell you:

steps.name: Oakcup
steps.text: Go northward to ask the Cyclopes for help on how to get home.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think I'm willing to give it a shot. What about you guys?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: If there's a chance, we might as well take it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...If it really works out, I suppose I'll go along.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Chilchuck?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: The three of you already agreed to go, so is there any point in asking me?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Of course there is, you're a member of our party too.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...I'll be honest then.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I'm against it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Do you not trust Oakcup?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That's not it. I can tell he's not lying.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Then why not?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Prophecies, divination... you guys are way too willing to believe that stuff.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What if someone planned this all out? Dropped two pieces of bark here and is trying to cheat us? Again?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: He has a point. But I still think there's no harm in heading north a bit further.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If we run into another shaman, we just have to ask them to read the bark and we'll know if Oakcup was telling the truth or not.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We've been here for a while now, so I wouldn't want to miss even a chance of finding a way home.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Speaking of going north though, why do I feel like we've been wandering around in circles this whole time?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Haven't we already walked past here before?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...I made some markers. I'm sure we've been making progress.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's wrong, Chilchuck?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Senshi's right. But the terrain here is making me feel uneasy.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Like the land itself has been shifting the whole time...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You mean like the dungeon?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah, something like that. But while the dungeon is always changing on the inside, this place is... the entire forest seems to be changing.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Look, there's a cliff up ahead. I'll go scout the terrain.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What was that?
The four look towards the source of the sound, and see a monster resembling a bull.
—Of course, they know by now to call it a 'hornbeast.'
A creature showing up in the forest should be a common sight, but this hornbeast has still drawn their attention... For one reason—
On its face is a black... black? No, it is a blank, an endless void.
The first thing that comes to mind is the galaxy of stars one can see in the night sky.
A cow with a void as its face. They find this reality hard to believe.
What's even more shocking is what lies dead center in the blank space. A circle.
An uncannily perfect circle.
A circle somehow even darker than the void surrounding it.
Darker than the night, deeper than the void.
But how can this dark circle seem to emit light?
Because it isn't. The circle is really a hole that sucks in all the light near it, to the point that it seems to be glowing.
Darker than the night, brighter than the light...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well... this is a strange monster.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The void on its face doesn't seem to be part of its usual biology.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Fascinating. I really want to study it.

steps.name: Corrupted Hornbeast
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sounds like it's angry!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: There are wounds on its body, from weapons... Someone's riled it up, and now it thinks we're the enemy!
Eat my axe!

steps.name: Corrupted Hornbeast
steps.text: (Pained howl)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wow does that girl have a ton of weapons...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Damn, the cliff's collapsing! Chilchuck!
Laios immediately sprints towards Chilchuck on the cliff, but is one step too late—
Chilchuck tries to jump backward to catch the outstretched hand, but Laios fails to grab him and can only watch as the Half-foot falls off the cliff.
